jobs.title: Head of Domain, Technology Development
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**
===============


Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified "Great Place to Work™." We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web\-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab's open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third\-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we're looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities \- ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it's like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.
**Who you are:**
================



Geotab is looking for entrepreneurial product and business leaders to head our domains – focused teams that each own a customer outcome and the business results that come with it. As a Head of Domain, you'll own the strategy, roadmap and results for your area, lead a multi\-disciplinary team of product managers, designers and engineers, and turn customer problems into products that customers adopt and pay for.


**What you'll do:**
===================



This is a role for someone who has **built and sold something**: a leader who measures success by business results, not by what shipped, and who uses AI to change how work gets done. You'll report to Geotab's Technology Development Board and operate with real autonomy as the business owner of your domain.



We welcome applicants nationwide! If you're based near one of our office hubs, this role follows our hybrid model, blending the comfort of working from home with regular on\-site days to connect and collaborate.


*This is an evergreen posting. We're building a pipeline of exceptional leaders for current and future domain leadership opportunities across Technology Development.*


**How you'll make an impact:**
==============================


* **Own the outcome.** Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your domain and be accountable for its primary business results – adoption, revenue, retention and customer impact.
* **Run it like a business.** Make clear build, buy and partner decisions, prioritize by customer and revenue impact, and say no when the return isn't there.
* **Stay close to customers.** Ground your team in customers' real experience to find the problems worth solving, and work with sales, support and partners to bring solutions to market.
* **Lead the AI shift.** Redesign how your domain works around AI to move faster, and help others across the organization do the same.
* **Build a high\-performing team.** Hire the right talent without settling, place people where their strengths matter most, set a clear and high bar, and develop the next generation of leaders.
* **Work across Geotab.** Partner closely with platform, segment and other domain leaders, contribute beyond your own goals, and help shape strategy with the Technology Development Board.
* **Manage your investment.** Own your domain's people and budget plan, make investment cases, and report on results and risks to the board.

**What you'll bring to this role:**
===================================


* 10\+ years of experience in product management, product engineering, or related customer\-facing product roles.
* 5\+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross\-functional scope and direct accountability for customer\-facing business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).
* Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer\-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P\&L literacy and revenue attribution.
* Cross\-functional leadership experience managing teams across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with proven capability in identifying and coaching high\-potential leaders.
* Excellent stakeholder management, change readiness, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving organizational structures.
* Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud\-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort.

jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

The Director of AI Engineering, Corporate IT leads the engineering of artificial intelligence for internal enterprise delivery, from strategy and architecture through production delivery. This role builds secure, scalable and responsible AI capabilities that modernize enterprise systems, automate IT operations and improve employee productivity.  



  

**What will you do?**

  

**AI Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Own the Corporate IT AI strategy and roadmap, aligned with CIO and enterprise priorities.
* Lead intake, value assessment and prioritization of AI use cases across functions such as Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Procurement etc.
* Manage AI licensing, vendor contracts and cloud spend within the IT budget.
* Rationalize AI tools, reduce duplication and address unapproved or shadow AI use.
* Assess emerging capabilities, including copilots, agents and SaaS AI features, for enterprise fit.

**Enterprise AI Patterns, Architecture \& Integration**

* Define AI patterns and align them with Enterprise Architecture standards.
* Guide integration of AI with collaboration platforms and enterprise data services.
* Govern build\-versus\-buy decisions across packaged AI, SaaS capabilities and custom solutions.
* Align AI solutions with identity and access management, single sign\-on, API gateways and enterprise data platforms.
* Act as the AI design authority in relevant architecture review forums.

**AI Platform, AIOps \& Automation**

* Build and operate enterprise AI platform capabilities, including LLM gateways, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector stores, prompt management and evaluation.
* Deliver AIOps capabilities such as event correlation, anomaly detection and automated remediation.
* Apply AI to IT service management, including ticket triage, routing, virtual agents and knowledge search.
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps pipelines integrated with IT change and release management.
* Monitor model quality, drift, hallucination risk, service performance and inference cost.

**Security, Risk \& Responsible AI**

* Embed information security, data classification and data loss prevention requirements across AI services.
* Protect AI solutions against data leakage, prompt injection and model abuse.
* Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance and Privacy to establish and operate AI controls.
* Support privacy, SOX, model\-risk and audit requirements for AI\-enabled corporate processes.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of AI solutions and an approved\-tools catalogue.

**People, Talent \& Adoption**

* Lead AI engineering, platform and automation teams and establish clear accountabilities.
* Design roles, career paths and team structures that build sustainable AI capability within Corporate IT.
* Mentor IT employees in AI engineering and secure, responsible AI practices.
* Drive employee AI adoption and literacy in partnership with corporate function owners.
* Manage strategic partners and managed service providers and hold them accountable for outcomes.

**IT Service Delivery \& Operations**

* Deliver AI initiatives through established portfolio, change, release and governance processes.
* Own service\-level expectations, support models, runbooks and operational readiness for AI services.
* Partner with corporate function owners to define outcomes and realize measurable value.
* Report value, risk, delivery and spend to the CIO and IT leadership.
* Lead change management and communications for AI rollouts.

**What do you need to succeed?**

* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions into production, supported by a strong foundation in software engineering, data engineering or machine learning.
* Experience designing AI engineering patterns and guiding engineering teams through technical implementation while remaining actively involved in solution development.
* Proficiency with Python and experience with data integration, data pipelines or extract, transform and load processes.
* Experience with cloud AI services and application programming interfaces on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or both.
* Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation and production monitoring.
* Experience navigating information security, data protection, responsible AI and technology\-governance requirements in a complex enterprise environment.
* Ability to explain complex technical recommendations to engineering teams, senior leaders and business stakeholders, mentor colleagues and build alignment across teams.
* Experience working in a regulated or highly governed enterprise environment.
* Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or AI\-related training or certification.

**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


Join RBC's Enterprise Performance Management team to provide strategic financial advice to senior leadership, including the CFO, Group Executives, and Board of Directors. You'll deliver timely, insightful analysis that informs critical business decisions and supports long\-term bank performance. Working across all platforms and business segments, you'll develop strong relationships with diverse stakeholders while driving continuous improvement in how we measure and optimize enterprise performance.

**What will you do?**

* Build knowledge and provide an integrated view of enterprise performance through preparation for senior management.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of strategic reports that inform executive decision\-making
* Synthesize enterprise performance data, strategic insights, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence into strategic briefs and deep dives for senior leadership
* Deliver high quality work that is produced efficiently within tight timelines.
* Leverage AI and advanced analytics to surface insights from enterprise performance and market data. Translate AI outputs into strategic narratives and recommendations that drive executive action.
* Support key RBC enterprise priorities while establishing, monitoring, and maintaining effective plans and controls to ensure that they are completed on time.

* MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field

Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.  

  

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re\-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.

 **Sourcing Data, Reporting \& Performance Intelligence**

* Own the Sourcing data and analytics agenda, defining priorities for data quality, accessibility, governance and effective use in commercial and strategic decision\-making.

---------------


The Director, Product Analytics will lead the Product Analytics function within Group Benefits, with primary accountability for using data and analytics to deepen understanding of our products, customers and members and to support better product and business decisions.

  

  

The incumbent will shape the strategy and evolution of Product Analytics, partnering closely with Product, Distribution and other business leaders to provide trusted, relevant and actionable insights across the product lifecycle. The role will help identify emerging trends, understand product performance and customer needs, evaluate opportunities and support decisions that strengthen our Group Benefits products and the value they provide to Canadians.

  

  

Through better use of data and insights, the Director will help connect product decisions to customer and member outcomes, supporting the broader ambition of improving the health and well\-being of Canadians.

  

  

In addition to Product Analytics, the Director will contribute to and lead broader analytics initiatives across Group Benefits where the team's capabilities, data and expertise can create value. This may include customer and member analytics, portfolio insights, operational analytics, strategic business priorities and emerging analytical needs.

jobs.title: AVP, Promo Operations, Planning & Integration
jobs.description:
Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most trusted companies and one of the country’s most recognized retail brands. Across Canadian Tire Retail, Mark’s, SportChek, Triangle Rewards and Canadian Tire Bank, we are investing in technology, data and talent to create better experiences for Canadians. This is an exciting time to join CTC and help shape how data and AI drive our next chapter of growth.

  

  

Reporting to the Vice\-President, Pricing \& Promotions, the AVP, Promo Operations \& Integration leads enterprise strategy and operations for print production, distribution and gift\-card programmes across Canadian Tire Corporation’s retail banners.

  

  

The AVP aligns print investment, production and coverage with flyer strategy, promotional calendars and banner priorities to deliver reliable, cost\-effective programmes with measurable customer and commercial value. This AVP role also leads cross\-functional planning and integration of strategic and operational programs, including True North program management support, enterprise promotional calendar management and project support for emerging initiatives. Working closely with Pricing \& Promotion, Marketing, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Store Operations and other cross\-functional partners, the AVP will help connect promotional planning with effective customer\-facing execution.

**Enterprise print and distribution strategy**

* Develop a multi\-year print and distribution strategy aligned with customer needs, promotional priorities and the price\-value agenda.
* Lead the effective planning and delivery of flyer and print requirements, balancing customer impact, operational effectiveness, cost and business priorities.
* Translate banner priorities into production and distribution plans that balance reach, commercial impact, cost and feasibility.
* Advise senior leaders on print’s role alongside digital and personalized communications.
* Simplify programmes and modernise capabilities, processes, tools and vendor partnerships to improve enterprise leverage.
  

  

**Flyer and promotional integration**

* Align print and distribution plans with flyer strategy, promotional calendars, major retail events and banner priorities.

* Establish cross\-functional governance and operating rhythms with Marketing, Merchandising, Customer Strategy, Supply Chain, Store Operations and Finance to align priorities, timelines and accountabilities and resolve competing demands.
  

  

**Production and operational excellence**

* Lead print and distribution operations from demand planning and programme set\-up through quality assurance and delivery.
* Set service standards, controls, escalation processes and measures to ensure accurate, timely delivery within quality and cost requirements.
* Lead contingency planning and resolve supply, capacity, production and distribution risks to critical promotional events.

* Supports the digital evolution of print programs based on customer insights and analytics.
* Use financial insights and operational results to track performance, prioritize improvements and adapt execution plans as promotional priorities and business requirements change.
  

  

**Strategic sourcing and partner management**

* Set the sourcing and partner strategy for print, distribution and related services with Procurement.
* Govern strategic suppliers through service\-level agreements, capacity planning, risk management and continuous improvement.
* Support major negotiations to secure value, flexibility, quality and service.
* Build transparent relationships with printers, distributors, logistics partners and specialist providers.
* Monitor emerging print, distribution, sustainability and measurement capabilities.
* Maintain supplier contingency and business\-continuity plans.
  

  

**Gift\-card programme leadership**

* Lead enterprise gift\-card programme priorities and operational performance, aligning banner, partner and operational needs.
* Partner with Digital, Technology, Finance, Legal and other stakeholders on programme changes and capabilities.
* Strengthen gift\-card operational controls, processes and execution, partnering across banners and functions to improve the customer experience and programme effectiveness.
  

  

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment that connects team priorities to enterprise and customer outcomes.
* Build succession depth and cross\-functional capability, leading teams through change and the adoption of new processes, technology and ways of working.
* Lead cross\-functional planning and integration of strategic and operational programs, including True North program management support, enterprise promotional calendar management and project support for pricing \& promotions initiatives.

jobs.title: AVP, Actuarial Projects & Transformation
jobs.description:
**Welcome to** ***ivari***  

Let us introduce ourselves. With 300\+ employees across Canada, *ivari* is a company that’s making a difference in the world of life insurance. How? By finding and hiring employees who are passionate about helping people protect their families, and by giving them the best, most supportive workplace possible. *ivari* is part of Sagicor Financial Corporation, a leading financial services provider based in the Caribbean, with a strong presence in North America. We offer a wide range of products and services, including life and health insurance, annuities, pension administration and investment services.  

At *ivari*, everyone is welcome! It is our mission to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and the communities in which we do business. We offer an inclusive and accessible work environment where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. **Here’s the job opportunity…**  

This position is an existing vacancy.  

Reporting to the VP, FP\&A and Central Actuarial, this role will support actuarial projects, strategic initiatives, actuarial system maintenance and transformation. This role serves as the bridge between Corporate Actuarial, Finance, Technology, Operations, and external vendors to deliver enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives.


The role combines project leadership, actuarial expertise, actuarial systems oversight, and people leadership. **As the AVP, Actuarial Projects and Transformation, your key responsibilities will include…****Actuarial Strategic Projects and Production Support**

* Support strategic and emerging actuarial projects in response to business priorities, regulatory developments, transactions, and other complex issues requiring actuarial leadership and analysis.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workstreams, bringing together appropriate expertise from Corporate Actuarial, Finance, Investments, Risk, Pricing, Technology, and other teams.
* Translate complex actuarial analysis into clear recommendations and executive\-level insights, including identification of key risks, trade\-offs, and areas of uncertainty.
* Act as a flexible senior actuarial resource for the Chief Actuary and actuarial leadership team on high\-priority or time\-sensitive issues requiring focused analysis and support broader Corporate Actuarial deliverables as needed.
* Establish appropriate documentation, controls, and handover into Business\-as\-Usual processes where an ad hoc initiative becomes an ongoing responsibility.
 **Actuarial Systems Transformation and Ownership**

* Actuarial lead for initiatives such as modernizing general ledger and policy administration system.
* Lead actuarial system upgrades (e.g. Moody’s RiskIntegrity and AXIS).
* Partner with Actuarial, Finance, Technology, and Operations teams to implement automation and process improvements.
* Ensure appropriate system maintenance, support, and operational stability.
* Provide ongoing oversight for actuarial production environments.
 **Leadership \& Talent Development**

* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of actuaries and actuarial students.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical guidance to team members.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and collaboration.
* Build strong relationships across actuarial, finance, investments, risk, and business teams.
 **What we are looking for…*** Fellow of the Canadian Institute of Actuaries.
* University degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or a related field.
* Minimum of 10\-15 years of relevant experience in Life insurance.
* Demonstrated success leading large, cross\-functional transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of actuarial valuation, financial reporting under IFRS 17, LICAT, and insurance operations.
* Knowledge of actuarial systems (e.g. RiskIntegrity, AXIS).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, focusing on relevant information and being able to explain complex concepts in easily understandable terms to a wide range of audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, capable of influencing and engaging across all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor a high\-performing team.
 **What we pay…**
An attractive total compensation package commensurate with the successful candidate's experience and qualifications.

 **What's in it for you…**
At ivari, it's important for us to keep our people motivated, recognized and rewarded. We offer competitive base salaries plus a bonus, one of the many reasons ivari is a great place to work.


We also offer health and dental benefits for the entire family from Day 1! But that’s just the beginning. When you join the ivari team you also get…

* Competitive compensation and annual bonus opportunity
* Comprehensive health and dental benefits \[for you and your family]
* Pension and employee savings plans with company matching contributions
* Hybrid work arrangement with dedicated in\-office collaboration days
* Competitive vacation and paid time\-off programs
* Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
* Collaborative culture where individual contributions have visible impact
* Wellness programs supporting physical and mental health

Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.  

  

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re\-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.


As the Senior Director, Sourcing Strategy \& Value Delivery, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for defining and driving the strategic agenda of Loblaw's Sourcing organization, translating enterprise priorities into measurable business outcomes. Reporting to the SVP, Enterprise Sourcing, you will serve as a key strategic partner and extension of the SVP's leadership, working closely with the Chief Sourcing Officer and Sourcing Leadership to shape critical business decisions, establish priorities, and drive transformational change across the organization.

  

At the heart of this mandate is the Sourcing Centre of Excellence, responsible for accelerating strategic initiatives, driving enterprise value delivery, and evolving Sourcing capabilities and ways of working. You will lead the strategic planning process, oversee the portfolio of highest\-priority enterprise programs, and establish the governance and operating rhythm required to drive accountability, navigate complex trade\-offs, and deliver against financial and operational objectives.

  

Beyond setting direction, you will be expected to exercise independent judgment, represent Enterprise Sourcing in senior leadership forums, and drive alignment and action across a complex, matrixed organization. Combining strategic vision, commercial acumen, and disciplined execution, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Sourcing's enterprise impact and advancing our ambition to be the World's Best Buyers.

 **Core Responsibilities**

 **Executive Leadership \& Strategic Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic extension of the SVP, Enterprise Sourcing, representing the function in senior leadership discussions and cross\-functional forums, and advancing priorities independently within delegated authority.
* Act as a trusted thought partner to the Chief Sourcing Officer and Sourcing Leadership, bringing independent perspectives, sound commercial judgment, and constructive challenge to complex strategic and operational decisions.
* Anticipate emerging enterprise priorities, risks, and opportunities, proactively shaping the leadership agenda and recommending actions to strengthen organizational performance.
* Drive alignment and decision\-making across senior stakeholders, navigating competing priorities and complex trade\-offs to advance enterprise objectives.
* Exercise strong judgment in determining which matters require executive escalation, while independently resolving issues and driving progress wherever appropriate.

 **Strategic Planning**

* Lead the development and execution of Sourcing's annual and multi\-year strategic agenda, translating Enterprise objectives into clear priorities, actionable plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the annual strategic planning process, partnering with Sourcing Leadership to identify the highest\-impact opportunities, evaluate strategic choices, and align resources and investments against Enterprise priorities.
* Own the development of executive\-level strategic narratives and communications, including Board materials, annual planning, Management Board presentations, and Quarterly Business Reviews, ensuring a clear and compelling articulation of Sourcing's priorities, performance, and value.
* Proactively identify emerging business challenges, market dynamics, and opportunities, leading strategic problem\-solving and cross\-functional initiatives to strengthen competitive advantage.

 **Enterprise Value Delivery**

* Establish and lead the enterprise Sourcing value delivery framework, ensuring clear financial and operational targets, accountable owners, milestones, and performance measures across initiatives
* Drive rigorous performance management across the portfolio of priority enterprise programs, challenging assumptions, identifying delivery gaps, and ensuring timely corrective action.
* Hold program and functional leaders accountable for commitments, facilitating difficult conversations and resolving cross\-functional barriers to protect enterprise outcomes.
* Partner with Finance and functional leaders to validate financial impacts, assess risks and opportunities, and maintain a credible forward\-looking view of value delivery.
* Proactively identify emerging performance risks and opportunities, mobilizing recovery plans and escalating material issues with clear recommendations and decision options.
* Translate enterprise ambitions into executable plans, ensuring strategic initiatives deliver sustainable business outcomes rather than simply achieving project milestones.

 **Operating Rhythm \& Governance**

* Lead Sourcing’s run\-the\-business and transform\-the\-business forums, including period reviews and steering committees.

* Partner with the Senior Director, Sourcing Analytics, who owns the AI capability roadmap, to prioritize business transformation outcomes.
